info.name: Match My Jobs REST API
info.description:
Complete production REST API collection for Match My Jobs / AntiGravite platform.
Includes all endpoints for Authentication, Profiles, Jobs, Candidate actions, Resumes, AI Matching, Recruiter/Company workflows, and Super Admin / Platform Administration.

request.description: Verify server status, version, and running features.
Public registration for Company Owners (creates company organization).
Standard login. Automatically saves accessToken & refreshToken.
Dedicated login for Platform Admin & Admin Managers. Saves adminToken.
Fetch current authenticated user profile and permissions.
Exchange refresh token for a new access token.
